cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Fluent in Nonsense
cards.instruction: Perform complete mastery of the strange logic while inventing each rule only when it becomes necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get your sofa off the ceiling. Turn the gravity dial politely. I taught you not to rush a move, didn't I?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm losing my deposit. What does politely mean?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pause at each number. They dislike being passed over. You still hurry past the awkward part, just like your first piano removal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paused at six. Now the armchairs are rising too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well done, you've got the whole suite's attention. Apologise to all of it; you can't whisper an apology once the furniture has assembled.
